name: Ai no Kuchita Rakuen
source:
In the lecture hall, where this all began, you girls now gather to bring an end.

Each of you is burdened by a weight - of common secrets, or of Shino's tragic fate. 

Whatever else, find the thief who took her life. Show to who it was that the real Shino really gave her heart.

[Adapted from [url=https://x.com/hi60t0/status/2115065793079832744]the trailer[/url].]
translation:
In the lecture hall, where this all began, you girls now gather to bring an end.

Each of you is burdened by a weight - of common secrets, or of Shino's tragic fate. 

Whatever else, find the thief who took her life. Show to who it was that the real Shino really gave her heart.

[Adapted from [url=https://x.com/hi60t0/status/2115065793079832744]the trailer[/url].]
